description: Land Acquisition - Halpola and Medakubura, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Amendments to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1549/1 of 12.05.2008 by Biyagama 	D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices for acquiring specific parcels of land (including detailed descriptions, locations, extents, and claimant information) for the Upper Kotmale Hydro Power Project. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in the "PART III — LANDS" section of the gazette, confirming its primary focus on land-related administrative matters.
